title: Support ticket lifecycle, SLA, test visibility, and dedupe integrity

phases.objective: Prevent cross-context dedupe, classify test records from trusted evidence, calculate milestone-aware SLA, and persist ticket integrity atomically.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Ticket creation uses structured dedupe and atomic integrity persistence; the tenant inbox returns only customer-safe fields, excludes trusted internal tests, and preserves latest activity order.
steps: Resolve one unambiguous active tenant membership.
Build the v2 dedupe identity from tenant, user, type, capability, resource, relationship, intended parent, test classification, environment, and visibility.
Verify migration 1042 schema readiness before mutation.
Create or append the ticket and persist integrity fields in one database transaction.
List only the requesting user's or workspace-shared customer-safe records without internal tests and order them by latest real activity.
assertions: Different parent tickets and target capabilities produce different dedupe keys.
Production, test, environment, and visibility contexts cannot dedupe onto one another.
Multiple active memberships require an explicit tenant_id instead of selecting the first candidate.
Schema-not-ready creation fails before ticket mutation.
Integrity persistence failure rolls back ticket creation or dedupe append.
Completed response and triage milestones do not create false SLA breaches.
Ordinary title words cannot classify a genuine request as a test; explicit false wins.
Tenant list responses omit internal summaries, internal actor/source data, and other database-only fields.

phases.objective: Expose cursor-paged dry-run findings and guarded apply reconciliation while deriving durable SLA milestones from governed lifecycle events.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The administrator receives lifecycle, SLA, visibility, relationship, milestone-evidence, assignment, and continuation findings; apply remains schema- and confirmation-gated.
steps: Authenticate the administrator and backend API key.
Inspect schema readiness and calculate one keyset-paged finding batch.
Return dry-run evidence and next_cursor without mutation.
Require typed confirmation and schema readiness before transactional apply.
Backfill durable first-response and triage timestamps from governed lifecycle events.
assertions: Apply fails closed until migration 1042 is present.
Urgent unassigned and test-ticket counts are explicit.
Reconciliation can continue beyond the newest 250 tickets through a stable keyset cursor.
Migration 1042 backfills existing lifecycle evidence and installs an idempotent single-statement milestone trigger.

phases.objective: Prove pre-migration read fallback and failure isolation through a real synthetic runtime.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: A synthetic Express runtime with a pre-migration database contract
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Tenant reads remain available through fallbacks while creation and schema-dependent apply fail closed before mutation and legacy routes remain reachable.
steps: Start the route stack against a pre-migration schema fixture.
Verify tenant list fallback and trusted test suppression.
Attempt ticket creation and verify schema-not-ready rejection before mutation.
Attempt apply reconciliation and verify a typed schema-not-ready rejection.
Verify legacy detail and workflow routes remain reachable.

phases.objective: Apply migration 1042 in an authorized non-production database and read back audited tickets.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Governed migration apply followed by dry-run and typed apply reconciliation
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: The canary database exposes required columns and trigger, and audited records read back with corrected lifecycle, visibility, relationship, milestone, and SLA state.
steps: Apply migration 1042 under separate authorization.
Read schema readiness, milestone_trigger_count, and migration ledger evidence.
Run dry-run reconciliation through every cursor page, inspect findings, then apply approved corrections.
Verify audited ticket IDs and tenant inbox exclusion.

phases.objective: Promote the reviewed head, apply the migration, and verify customer-safe Production readback.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Production promotion, governed migration apply, and post-deploy reconciliation
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Production reports exact SHA, migration evidence, corrected ticket states, test exclusion, customer-safe projection, durable milestones, and milestone-aware SLA.
steps: Promote the reviewed exact head through the governed Production process.
Apply migration 1042 under separate authorization.
Run cursor-paged dry-run then approved typed apply reconciliation.
Verify exact ticket IDs, inbox ordering, customer-safe fields, SLA status, and tenant-safe readback.
